# Web form specs — the author's reference

## Contents

- What the compiler refuses
- The form
- Pages
- Fields
- Rules
- Template-linked forms
- Replacing a form (versions)
- Not supported, and why

How to write `assets/webforms/specs/<id>.json`, the short file that `src/webform-spec.ts` compiles
into the configuration **Start ▸ Web Forms ▸ Upload Configuration** (the help's *Upload Web Form*) takes. This page lists every key
the compiler reads. It says what each key compiles to, and whether that output was proven live.
[WEB_FORMS-CONFIG.md](WEB_FORMS-CONFIG.md) is the reference for the *configuration* and for the
evidence behind it. This page covers the *spec*.

```bash
npx tsx captures/webform-compile.ts                     # spec → assets/webforms/configs/<id>.json (offline)
DS_ACCOUNT=legacy npx tsx captures/webform-verify.ts assets/webforms/specs/<id>.json   # the five gates (live)
```

The library's 45 forms are **generated** from `src/webform-library/`, so edit there, not the spec.
`kitchen-sink.json` and `rule-probe.json` are hand-written lab fixtures.

**Proven** in the tables below means one of these:
- **live**: a measured effect in Preview, cited from WEB_FORMS-CONFIG.md §4/§5 or a probe's `RESULT.json`;
- **gates**: used by a spec that passed all five gates (upload, round trip, builder, preview, activate). That shows it uploads, activates and renders. The Preview walker answers each field once, with its example or first option, so a gate pass does not show that a check fires;
- **no**: never uploaded.

## What the compiler refuses

`buildWebformConfig()` runs `validateSpec()` first and throws on any problem. A spec that compiles is
never silently changed. Refused:

| Problem | Why |
|---|---|
| A key used twice (fields, Sections, hidden fields) | The second field overwrote the first, and the page listed the survivor twice: one field disappeared without an error |
| A page `key` equal to a field key, or to another page key | A rule naming it would be ambiguous |
| An unknown key anywhere, or a key that does not apply to the field's type (`default` on a number, `select` on a dropdown, `requried`) | These were dropped without a word |
| An unknown `type` | — |
| A product limit: type `repeating` / `repeatingGroup` / `repeat`, type `formula` / `calculated` or a `formula` key, a `checkDigit` key, a spec-level `finishLater` | The product has none; the message names the workaround: fixed numbered sections with show rules; a document template or eSignature formula; a pattern plus a later check; the link's `?showFinishLater=false` |
| `preset`, `numberFormat`, `dateFormat` or `locale` outside the measured values | The server stores any string (WEB_FORMS-CONFIG.md §2); only the listed ones were measured |
| `currency` outside the builder's Currency Type list; `countryCode` that is not 1–3 digits | The panel's own list (harvest, 2026-10-24); `"44"` (no `+`) was measured |
| A date `default` not in the field's display format; a number/currency default that is not a number; a phone default that is not digits | An ISO date default failed activation (InvalidText) |
| A `required` field on the hidden page | The respondent cannot fill it |
| An attachment on the hidden page, or more than 15 attachments | docs/WEB-FORMS-GUIDE.md rule 9 (ymm1721679198157) |
| A `formats` entry with a dot or capitals | The builder's own list is bare lower-case extensions |
| A `pattern` that does not compile, is not anchored `^…$`, or whose example does not match it | The runtime calls `new RegExp(p).test(v)`, unanchored (§5) |
| `select` bounds outside 0…number of options, `exactly` mixed with `atLeast`/`atMost`, or `atLeast > atMost` | A form that can never advance |
| More than one `selected` option on a dropdown or radio | A single-answer field |
| An empty page title, Welcome title or button, or Thank-you title; a Thank-you button with blank text or URL | The builder marks these required (gallery/text/templates/42g, 42-webform-add-a-field); docs/WEB-FORMS-GUIDE.md §2a (vgq1683244272836) |
| A rule condition without exactly one operator; a number or currency condition whose value is not a number | The value compiled to `NaN` |
| A date condition whose value is not ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` | Measured: the runtime never matches a display-format date |
| A rule naming a field or page the spec does not have; an effect other than `show`/`hide` | A dead rule; WEB_FORMS-CONFIG.md §5 |

`validateWebformConfig()` then checks the compiled config: structure, names, option values, the
Thank-you URL, a component listed twice, and a regex that does not compile. `webformWarnings()`
reports things that work but may surprise you. None of them block an upload:
- a target with two rules (visible while unanswered);
- a rule target placed before its trigger: Preview showed such a target before the trigger was answered, so the rule does not hide it (lab `zz-rule-backward`, legacy, 2026-10-24);
- read-only with no default;
- a nested Section or a required hidden field in a hand-edited config;
- an unanchored regex in an export;
- builder placeholder labels;
- account-bound verification apps.

The library's `finalize()` (src/webform-library/blocks.ts) adds its own conventions on top:
- one rule per target;
- every pattern carries an example;
- non-US phones carry a local example;
- no two co-visible fields share a label;
- Section rules are expanded onto their inputs;
- untitled Sections are dissolved.

## The form

| Key | Type | Default | Compiles to | Proven |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string, required | — | `formProperties.name` | live |
| `description` | string | — | nothing: documentation only | — |
| `locale` | `"en"` \| `"ja"` \| `"es"` \| `"pt_BR"` \| `"de"` \| `"fr"` \| `"it"` \| `"nl"` | `"en"` | `formLocale` (the builder has no control for it) | gates (all; `contact-inquiry-es` in the library). The builder's Preview shows the viewer's own language for every locale, so the built-in strings a respondent sees are not observed |
| `access` | `"public"` \| `"private"` | `"public"` | Private means API only, with no public link. Upload ignores `formProperties.isPrivateAccess`, so `webform-verify.ts` sets it the way the builder does, at activation (WEB_FORMS-CONFIG.md §9) | live: `isPrivateAccess` true on the active form (`zz-private`, 2026-10-25) |
| `welcome` | `{ title, text?, button? }` \| `false` | `{ title: name }`, button `"Start"` | `Welcome` (`text`, `subText` Markdown, `startButtonText`); `false` = no Welcome page | gates (both) |
| `hidden` | Field[] | — | A `Step` with `stepMode: "prefill"`, placed FIRST. **Needs Advanced Web Forms** (IAM Professional+); without a `default`, only Workflow Builder mapping or the API fills it | gates (renders). **API prefill live**: `POST …/forms/{id}/instances` with `formValues` stored hidden, visible and read-only values exactly. URL `#name=value` prefill renders on a demo account, but its submit failed ("Form not submitted"), so it is unproven (WEB_FORMS-CONFIG.md §6) |
| `pages` | Page[], required | — | one `Step` each, in order | gates |
| `summary` | `{ title?, text? }` \| `false` | `"Summary"` / `"Please review the information you have entered:"` | `Summary`; `false` = no review page | gates (both) |
| `thankYou` | `{ title, text?, button?: { text, url } }` | `"Thank you"` / `"We've received your form."` | `Thankyou`; a button sets `showConfirmationButton`. The URL must be http(s) with a dotted host: a `mailto:` URL fails activation | gates; the button click is not walked |
| `rules` | Rule[] | — | `Root_Of_Journey.componentRules.componentRulesMap` | see Rules |

Always written, never in the spec: `isStandalone: true`, `templates: []`, `eSignTemplates: []`,
`isPrivateAccess: false` (Public), `Root.schemaVersion: 1` and a `FormSubmitAction`.

## Pages

| Key | Notes |
|---|---|
| `title` | required, non-empty; the page heading, repeated on the review page |
| `subtitle` | Markdown |
| `key` | optional, a stable id for rules that show or hide the whole page |
| `apiName` | optional, the page's API reference name, editable in the builder (default: its componentKey); gates |
| `fields` | the page's fields and Sections, in order |

## Fields

Every input field (not `description` or `section`) takes:
- `key`: the API reference name. Letters, digits and `_`, in any script, not starting with a digit. Unique in the form. It must not look like another type's auto-name, e.g. `Email_ab12cd34` on a text field.
- `label`, `description` (help text, shown as **plain text**: Markdown is not rendered there, measured), `required`, `readOnly`.
- `example`: a valid answer, which the verifier types. It is never compiled.

| `type` | `componentType` | Type keys | Defaults written | Proven |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `TextBox` | `placeholder`, `maxLength`, `preset` (`zip` \| `extendedZip` \| `ssn`), `pattern { regex, message, example? }`, `default` | `maxLength: 4000`, `multiLine: false` | live: placeholder, default, readOnly, maxLength; zip+4, ssn and pattern enforced on a bad answer (`--invalid`) |
| `longtext` | `TextBox` | `placeholder`, `maxLength`, `pattern`, `default`, `maxLineBreaks` | `multiLine: true` | live (renders a textarea); `maxLineBreaks` gates |
| `email` | `Email` | `placeholder`, `maxLength`, `default` | — | gates; maxLength enforced ("Input must not exceed 20 characters", `--invalid`) |
| `number` | `Number` | `placeholder`, `default`, `numberFormat` (`periodSeparatedNumber` \| `commaSeparatedNumber` \| `spacePeriod` \| `spaceComma`) | `periodSeparatedNumber` | live: period, comma; gates: spacePeriod, spaceComma (the builder's panel offers only Period and Comma); `default` live |
| `currency` | `Currency` | `currency` (one of the builder's 15: aud brl cad chf cny cop eur gbp inr jpy krw mxn sgd usd vnd), `default` (the amount, a number), `currencyEditable` ("Allow editing currency type") | `usd` | live: eur, gbp, default amount; gates: usd, jpy, `currencyEditable` |
| `date` | `Date` | `placeholder`, `dateFormat` (`MM_dd_yyyy` \| `dd_MM_yyyy` \| `yyyy_MM_dd`), `default` in the field's OWN display format (`11/02/2026` or `02/11/2026`; an ISO default fails activation, and a yyyy_MM_dd default is unmeasured) | `MM_dd_yyyy`; the placeholder comes from the format | live (date-probe; defaults in both measured formats) |
| `phone` | `PhoneNumber` | `countryCode` (digits, no `+`), `default` (the national number's digits → `defaultValue.nationalNumber`) | `"1"`, written to `defaultValue.countryCode`, which is the one the runtime reads | live (+44; default) |
| `dropdown` | `Select` | `options` | — | gates; `selected` live |
| `radio` | `RadioButtonGroup` | `options` | — | gates; option `description` live |
| `checkbox` | `CheckboxGroup` | `options`, `select { atLeast? , atMost? , exactly? }` | `SelectAtLeast`: 1 if required, else 0 | live: exactly; atMost and range enforced on a bad answer (`--invalid`) |
| `file` | `FileInput` | `formats` (bare extensions), `maxFileSizeInMB` | the builder's 33-format list; 25 MB | live (size shown); gates. **In a standalone form it works only inside a Workflow Builder Collect Data step**; on a public link the docs say attachments are not supported (see below) |
| `description` | `TextDescription` | `text` (Markdown) | — | live: bold and italic; Welcome text also renders links and lists |
| `section` | `Section` | `label` (the title), `text` (subtitle), `fields` (a Section may hold a Section: lab `zz-nested-section` imported, opened and previewed, the lab account 2026-11-02) | — | gates |

**Options** are a string (the label) or `{ label, value?, selected?, description? }`. The value
defaults to `optionValue(label)`, the builder's own rule: punctuation removed, spaces become `_`, and
a leading digit gets a `_` prefix. A value is an identifier. Rules name an option by label or by value,
and the compiler writes the value.

## Rules

```json
{ "when": [{ "field": "entity_type", "is": "LLC" }], "match": "all", "then": { "llc_members": "show" } }
```

- `when`: conditions, each `{ field, <operator>: value }` with exactly one operator.
- `match`: `all` (and, the default) or `any` (or).
- `then`: a map of target key to `show` or `hide`. A target is a field, a Section, a description or a page `key`.

A **hidden field is not validated**, so a field that is only sometimes required is written as
`required: true` plus a rule. `show` hides its target until the condition holds. Use one rule per
target.

### The allowed operators (one table, shared with request-type intake forms)

A rule may use only the operations the builder's rule editor offers for the field's type. The
compiler refuses anything else (`BUILDER_OPERATORS` in `src/webform-spec.ts`), naming the field,
its type, the operator and the allowed list. Request intake forms are built in the same builder,
so `src/request-type-spec.ts` uses the same table.

Sources:
- every palette type's operation list, read off the builder (`captures/recon-webform-properties.ts --only=operators`, 2026-10-25);
- the builder code's map from each operation to its runtime function (read 2026-10-25);
- the help topic "Add a Field Rule to a Web Form" (the list "depends on the field": is / is not, filled in / not filled in, contains, is on or after …).

| Field type | Builder's operations | Spec operator | Emits | Proven live |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| text, long text, email | is filled out / is not filled out | `filled: true/false` | `djTextValueIsFilledOut` / `…IsNotFilledOut` | yes |
| | is / is not | `is` `isNot` | `djTextValueEquals` / `…NotEquals` | yes |
| | contains / does not contain | `contains` `notContains` | `djTextValueContains` / `…NotContains` | yes |
| | starts with / ends with | `startsWith` `endsWith` | `djTextValueStartsWith` / `…EndsWith` | yes |
| | does not start with / does not end with | `notStartsWith` `notEndsWith` | `djTextValueNotStartsWith` / `…NotEndsWith` | compiled; lab fixture `rule-probe` (verify queued) |
| dropdown, radio | is filled out / is not filled out | `filled` | `djSelectValueIsFilledOut` / `…IsNotFilledOut` | in library forms |
| | is / is not / is any of / is not any of | `is` `isNot` `isAnyOf` `isNoneOf` | `djSelectValueEquals` `…NotEquals` `…IsAnyOf` `…IsNotAnyOf` | `is` yes; others in library forms |
| checkbox | is filled out / is not filled out | `filled` | `djMultiSelectValueIsFilledOut` / `…IsNotFilledOut` | yes |
| | includes any of / does not include any of | `isAnyOf` `isNoneOf` | `djMultiSelectValueIsAnyOf` / `…IsNotAnyOf` | yes |
| | is exactly / is not exactly | `is` `isNot` (a label or a list) | `djMultiSelectValueEquals` / `…NotEquals`, always with a **list** (a bare string never fires) | yes |
| date | is filled out / is not filled out | `filled` | `djDateValueIsFilledOut` / `…IsNotFilledOut` | yes |
| | is / is not (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`) | `is` `isNot` | `djDateValueEquals` / `…NotEquals` | yes |
| | is today | `today: true` | `djDateValueIsToday(key)` | yes |
| | is on or before / is on or after (ISO) | `onOrBefore` `onOrAfter` | `djDateIsOnOrBefore` / `…IsOnOrAfter` | yes (the builder itself writes an ISO literal) |
| | is on day of week | `onDayOfWeek: ["Monday", …]` | `djDateIsOnDayOfWeek(key, [1, …])`, Sunday = 0 | yes |
| number | is filled out / is not filled out | `filled` | `djTextValueIsFilledOut` / `…IsNotFilledOut` (the builder writes `djValueIsFilledOut`; both work) | yes |
| currency | is filled out / is not filled out | `filled` | `djCurrencyIsFilledOut` / `…IsNotFilledOut` | yes |
| phone | is filled out / is not filled out | `filled` | `djPhoneNumberIsFilledOut` / `…IsNotFilledOut` | yes |
| attachment | is filled out / is not filled out | `filled` | `djValueIsFilledOut` / `djValueIsNotFilledOut` | yes |
| section, description | — | not a condition | — | — |

**Refused since 2026-10-27, though the runtime evaluates them:**
- `gt` `gte` `lt` `lte` `is` `isNot` on a number or a currency (proven live: lab `zz-rule-number`, `zz-rule-currency`);
- `before` / `after` on a date (proven live: `zz-rule-date`).

The builder cannot show these rules, so a form that carries one cannot be opened and edited there. A
threshold ("over 250,000") needs another field: a dropdown of bands, for example.

The editor offers only targets that come AFTER the trigger, and `webformWarnings()` flags a rule
that aims backwards (unproven either way).

**Attachments in standalone forms work only inside a Workflow Builder workflow.** The official sources agree:
- The user guide (ymm1721679198157): "In standalone forms, attachment features are available only when the form is used in a Docusign Workflow Builder workflow. Standalone forms used outside a Workflow Builder workflow do not support attachment fields for recipients." Topic pbx1716585514741 says the same.
- The Web Forms API concepts page: "Attachment fields and envelope custom fields are not supported with standalone web form configurations."
- In a Workflow Builder Collect Data step, uploads "become document sources" for a later Send Documents for Signature step, at most 15 documents per step (yff/oha1716325069710).

The builder's palette still offers an Attachment on a standalone form, and our library's forms pass all five gates with one. That does not contradict the docs: Preview attaches a file but never submits. So a `file` field on a form meant for a **public link** should be treated as broken. `webformWarnings()` says so for every attachment, without blocking the upload. A person's submit through `webform-prefill-probe.ts --human --variant=file` would confirm it, but is no longer needed to decide it.

## Template-linked forms

A template-linked form fills an eSignature template with the answers, then its **Signature page**
has the respondent sign the envelope. The builder calls this *Transform a template*. Upload refuses
such a config (docs/WEB_FORMS.md, "Finding"), and its template connections name the tab ids of a
template COPY that exists only after the form is made. So it is not a file: a deploy step builds it
the way the builder does. Compiler: `src/webform-template-spec.ts`; proof:
`captures/webform-template-verify.ts`; library: `assets/webform-templates/specs/`.

```bash
npx tsx captures/webform-template-verify.ts assets/webform-templates/specs/<id>.json --cdp   # 8 gates (live)
```

```json
{ "id": "mutual-nda-request", "name": "Mutual NDA request (Fontara, Inc.)",
  "esign": "mutual-nda-fontara-inc", "filler": "Counterparty",
  "signing": { "fromEmail": true, "fieldEditing": false },
  "pages": [{ "title": "You", "fields": ["Counterparty_name", "Counterparty_email"] }, …],
  "labels": { "counterparty": "Company legal name" } }
```

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `esign` | the eSignature template's library spec (`assets/esign-templates/specs/<esign>.json`) |
| `filler` | the role that fills the form (default: the first signer); the other roles sign by email |
| `signing.fromEmail` | "Initiate signing session from email" (`ESignAction.requireRemoteSigning`); default false |
| `signing.fieldEditing` | "Enable document field editing" (`ESignAction.enableDocumentFieldEditing`); default true |
| `optionalRoles` | roles (not the filler) whose name and email fields are not required: a role left blank is left out of the envelope (help tzk1700529241643, "dynamic recipients"; its signature block stays on the document). Harvested 2026-11-01: clearing Required on the role's fields in the builder writes only `required: false` on those two components; lab `zz-wft-optional-role` PASS through activation. Run 2026-11-11 (`webform-template-submit-probe.ts`, plain Chrome over CDP): with the form's eSignature sender set (below), a submission with the role blank sent the envelope to the filler only, and with it filled to both roles. No library spec uses it yet |
| `welcome`, `thankYou` | as for a standalone form |
| `pages` | `{ title, subtitle?, fields }`: every form field exactly once; default one page |
| `labels`, `descriptions` | field key → label / help text |
| `hidden` | `[{ key, label?, default? }]`: text fields on a Hidden data page (a Step with `stepMode: "prefill"`, first in the filler's pages), filled by API prefill or Workflow Builder (URL prefill of a hidden or read-only field makes Submit answer 422, 2026-11-11); the respondent never sees them. A key may also be another signer's `<Role>_name` / `<Role>_email` with a `default`: the company fixes its own signer there instead of letting the respondent type it (the library's mutual NDA requests: Fontara's General Counsel). That field is then on no page [inferred: compiled and unit-tested; that a submission routes to the default is not proven yet] |
| `sender` | field key → Sender Controls: `hide`, `display` (optional) or `required` — whether a sender may pre-fill the field (`senderDisplayMode`; harvest L-WFT, a second lab account 2026-11-02) |
| `recipients` | role (not the filler) → `{ title, labels? }`: that signer also fills the form, on a page of its own (Manage Recipients; harvest B10-4, the lab account 2026-11-04). The server writes a disabled page set per other role; the deploy enables it with Welcome, one page of the role's text tabs (fields named by tab label, connected in `tabInfoMap` by the template copy's tab ids), Summary and the shared Signature page. A page or field cannot be given to another recipient. The builder marks it as Advanced Web Forms. Proven (activation) 2026-11-04, B10-4b |
| `documentRules` | `[{ when, match?, then: { <document file name>: "show" \| "hide" } }]`: show or hide a document of the envelope by the filler's answers (field ▸ Rules ▸ Documents; harvest B10-4). Conditions as for a standalone form; the document by its name in the compiled eSignature template; stored in `Root_Of_Journey.componentRules` with the Document keys of `ESignAction.documentInfoMap`. Offered only when the template has two or more documents. Proven (activation) 2026-11-04, B10-4b |
| Data Verification | none: a template-linked form offers no verification on an email, phone or text field (B10-4); verification is a standalone-form setting |
| `envelopeCustomFields` | text field key → `{ certificate?: true }`: "Save as envelope custom field" (named by the field's API name, value ≤ 255 characters; `useEnvelopeCustomField`) and "Show in Certificate of Completion" (`enableEnvelopeCustomFieldShowProperty`); it makes the field's Sender Controls required. The builder has no "sender must authorize" setting |

**The fields are the server's.** A field key is the componentName the server writes: the tab label
of each text tab of the filling role (the document template's field KEY), the group name of each
radio group (spaces → `_`, a `RadioButtonGroup` with the radios as options), and `<Role>_name` /
`<Role>_email` for EVERY role. The compiler refuses other signer tabs on the filling role (checkbox,
inline text, date, email, attachment): which field the server makes for them is not harvested.
Signature-block tabs and initials stay on the document [initials: inferred]. So the filler also types the other signers' names and emails, unless `hidden` fixes a signer with a default (a company never lets the counterparty choose its own signer). The
compiler checks every key against the compiled eSignature template. `_name`/`_email` for a role with a
space in its name is `[inferred]` (spaces → `_`).

How a deploy builds one (recorded off the builder, default account, 2026-10-30):

1. **Create** — `POST {webforms}/forms` with `{ features: { includeSenderView: true }, formProperties:
   { name }, includeAttachmentFields: false, templates: [{ templateId, recipientIds: ["1"],
   primaryRecipientId: "1" }] }`. The server copies the template ("Web Form Copy - <name>") and writes
   the form: a Welcome page, one page with the fields, Summary, the **Signature page** (an
   `ESignAction` component), Thank you. `ESignAction.tabInfoMap` connects each text tab of the copy
   (by tab id) to its field; `recipientInfoMap` names each role's name and email fields.
2. **Edit** — `GET ?state=draft`, apply the spec (`applyTemplateForm`), then `PATCH {webforms}/forms/{id}`
   with `{ formContentModifiedDateTime, formContent }`. This is the builder's own save.
3. **Activate** — `POST …/.publish`. Activation wires each connection: `tabInfoMap` gains
   `mergeFieldXml` with the path `ADM.Form.<field>` (for a radio group, on each of its `radios`).

Deleting the form moves its template copy to **Deleted Items**. The builder opens a form made this way
with "Name your web form" and then a "We created a new envelope template" notice.

**Edit Form on an active form makes a new copy** (lab tpl-legacy, a second lab account 2026-11-02): it shows
"We created a new envelope template for your form", replaces `templates[0].clonedTemplateId` with a new copy, and
changes every tab id in `ESignAction.tabInfoMap` (same `componentKeys` and `ADM` paths). A second edit made no further
copy. So read tab ids again after any edit in the builder; never keep them from the deploy.

Not proven: several filling roles (`recipientIds` with more than one id), non-text tabs other than radio groups,
attachments (`includeAttachmentFields`), rules on these fields.

## Replacing a form (versions)

A form has a draft and an active state (`GET …/forms/{id}?state=draft|active`; `hasDraftChanges`).
Activate turns the draft into the active state. Upload Configuration always makes a NEW form; it never
replaces one. So:
- to change a form in place, edit its draft (the builder, or `PATCH …/forms/{id}` with
  `formContent`, as a template-linked deploy does) and activate again;
- a Workflow Builder step that uses the form must then be re-applied (help:hjv1686940185785);
- the product keeps no older version to roll back to.
This is a deploy action, not a file setting, so no spec key models it.

## Not supported, and why

| Feature | Why |
|---|---|
| Template-linked forms by Upload | Upload refuses template-linked configs (docs/WEB_FORMS.md, "Finding"). Build them with a template-linked spec instead (above). Document rules and several filling roles are template-spec keys (`documentRules`, `recipients`) |
| Sender controls (`senderDisplayMode`), Save as envelope custom field | Seen only on template-linked forms, which are sent from the web app; a standalone form cannot be sent (`unsupportedSendingReason: "standalone"`) |
| Branding (`brandId`), Data Verification on email and phone (`xplatMetadata`) | Bound to one account's ids; `portableConfig()` strips them |
| Number range/decimals, currency format/min/max/decimals, phone format/character limit | Named in the help guide (§2b) but NOT in the builder's Properties panel. The harvest (`captures/recon-webform-properties.ts`, 2026-10-24) found no such controls |
| Default selections on a checkbox (several ticked) | The panel's default control is a multi-select button; its shape was not harvested. Use option `selected` |
| Attachment formats and size in the builder | The panel has no such controls; the config-only `formats`/`maxFileSizeInMB` are honoured (property-probe) |
| Attachment button/drag texts | In the builder's default config; never measured. `enableDMS: true` (also the builder's default) is always compiled: without it a Workflow Builder Send step does not get the uploaded file (Test 2, 2026-11-07) |
| Page Break | It just adds an empty page (a new `Step`); write another page instead |
| Signature, address, URL, time, country types; repeating groups; cross-field validation; masked input | The product has none (WEB_FORMS-CONFIG.md §12, "Approximations") |
